title: SAF workspace marker schema
description: Validation schema for .saf/workspace.yaml, committed at the Git top-level of a governed workspace (adapter spec github-copilot, Plugin mode: Workspace resolution). A folder whose Git top-level holds this marker, committed in HEAD, is a SAF workspace of the framework plugin it names.

framework.description: The framework plugin's name, as it registers itself in the per-user registry.

root.description: The workspace root: a top-level node slug of the framework's workspace layout (conf/workspace.conf.yaml).
